plan.title: Verify Linux input page residency and isolated guest cache reset controls

criteria.description: Read-only Linux mincore helper rejects symlinks, unexpected ownership and changed file identities; zero/partial residency and probe failures cannot manufacture a cold proof. Portable injected tests cover rejection paths.

On the prepared isolated Linux guest, observe warm positive control, controller-issued sync/page-cache reset, two zero-residency probes and re-read warm control. Keep explicit snapshot and race limits; no host-wide reset command or cold performance claim.

limitations: Guest-only integration runs separately through an E01-verified controller; portable tests do not prove Linux residency. Public helper is read-only and never writes drop_caches. Existing cold-cache measurement refusal remains; no timing/backend connection or thirty-sample P11 results.
